name: shinjuku-megadungeon
description: Shinjuku Station as a PS1-style megadungeon, built from MLIT's open indoor map.

scripts.data: python3 tools/build_mlit.py data/raw/mlit-shinjuku-indoor-shapefile.zip public/data/shinjuku.json shinjuku && python3 tools/build_mlit.py data/raw/mlit-tokyo-indoor-shapefile.zip public/data/tokyo.json tokyo
